justification: Assessment reported INVALID with the same defect as ground truth: the quadratic-root case analysis mis-signs one root in each parity case (roots of X^2 + sqrt5 X + 1 are {-phi, -phi^{-1}}, not {-phi, phi^{-1}}), so the disjunction phi^{m+1}=1 or -phi^{m-1}=1 is false and the converse yields F_{k'-1}=+1 instead of -1. It even uses the same odd-parity witness as ground truth (p=7, m=55, phi^55 = 1 - phi, phi^56 = -1 mod 49) and the same product-of-roots sanity check. Direct match to ground truth flaw and witness.
